datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule across Malawi administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases (IPC scale) for different scenarios and time periods in 2016, georeferenced to administrative boundaries and compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis.
